diagnostics.title: trusted definition performs an effect without policy allowance

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: Call the kernel through the compiler pipeline, or record the review with @trust-reviewed REASON.
diagnostics.title: untrusted definition reaches a trusted checking entry

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: Validate the input outside the trusted path, or record the review with @trust-reviewed REASON.
diagnostics.title: trusted definition reads a taint source

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: Move the dependency into the trusted set or mark the import as a reviewed TCB dependency with ouro-analyze:allow-trust-import.
diagnostics.title: trusted source depends on a source outside the declared TCB policy

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: Pass a term, not a Sort; types are erased at extraction.
diagnostics.title: Type/Sort used as a runtime value

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: Keep proofs and Sorts out of IO code paths.
diagnostics.title: proof or Sort under IO

diagnostics.rationale: See docs/quality.md for the stable diagnostic contract.
diagnostics.replacement: std must not depend on kernel entry points; move the caller to selfhost or tools.
diagnostics.title: kernel name referenced from std

profile_descriptions.baseline: safe default for external code using Ouro before opting into project policy
profile_descriptions.project: default policy for Ouro repository development
profile_descriptions.release: fail-closed profile used by CI/release gates for project-owned code
profile_descriptions.strict: maximal policy for new human-written Ouro code

profile_semantics.deny: diagnostic is an error; the gate fails
profile_semantics.forbid: diagnostic is an error and source-level suppressions are not honored
profile_semantics.warn: diagnostic is shown and recorded; build may pass
